User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application.

planTierId.description: Reference to the PlanTier. (Relationship: PlanTier 1:N User)

PlanTier.title: PlanTier
PlanTier.description: Represents a plan tier with specific features and limitations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the plan tier.

name.description: The name of the plan tier (e.g., Basic, Premium).

maxVisions.description: The maximum number of visions allowed for this plan tier.

aiFeaturesEnabled.description: Indicates whether AI features are enabled for this plan tier.

price.description: The monthly price of the plan.

features.description: A list of features included in the plan.

definition.description: Stores user profile data. Secured by path-based ownership, where only the user with the matching userId can access the document. Includes denormalized 'planTierId' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

definition.description: Stores plan tier information. Access control should be set up to restrict editing to admin users.

params.name: planTierId
params.description: The unique identifier for the plan tier.
